buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PQ Criteria 1. Average annual financial turnover during the last 3 years ending 31st March 20 26 should be at least 40 % of the estimated cost ₹ 3,00,393.23 (excluding all tax es, Labour cess), i.e. ₹ 1,20,157.00. Average ann ual financial turnover requirement specified for All Micro & Small Enterprises and all startups (whether MSE s or otherwise), falling within the definition as per Gazette notification–G.S.R. dated 23.05.2017 shall be rel axed by 25%.Turn over certificate/ Balance sheet for the financial year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 as me ntioned above in Pre-Qualification requirement issued by a Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN number i s acceptable 2. The supplier should be an authorized dealer of the OEM against this bid. 3. Copy of PAN. 4. Copy of GST Registration No. (Form REG-06). ATC/SPECIAL CONDITIONS 1. Bidder must submit OEM authorization certificate along with the bid. 2. Bidder must be compliance products detail technical specification as per Annexur e - ‘J’ with stamp & signature. 3. Organization/Institutions etc. in case of variation, p roper justification shall be submitted by the bidder. 7. After the stipulated time, no information/clarificatio n will be provided through any medium and no communication in this regard shall be entertained. 8. Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP addresses us ed by the Buyer and the Bidder(s) /Seller(s). The received Bids having matching/com mon IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation 9. Implementation of Anti Bribery Management System (ABMS): - THDCIL aim s to be successful in the long term and committed for prohibition of bribery through a culture of compliance with ant-bribery law, considering the needs and expectations o f interested parties. ABMS ISO 37001:2016 therefore has been implemented in THDCI L (Corporate office and NCR Office) w.e.f. 22/05/2024. Bidders to submit duly signed ABMS policy (attached in Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC). 10. The payments to the seller shall become due only after receipt of Performance Security by the Buyer and verification of its gen uineness. Actual date of receipt of original hard copy (Physical mode) of the PSD sub mitted in the forms other than NEFT/RTGS transfers (PBG/FD/DD etc) in the office of t he buyer shall be considered the date of submission of PSD. In case of delay/non-submission of the Performance Security within the stipulated tim e, a penalty shall be deducted from the bill of the supplier/contractor as per the slabs given below. DD should be made in favour of THDC India Limited payable at Rishikesh . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of THDC India Limited A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name THDC India Limited Account No. 10548872555 IFSC Code SBIN0001180 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address Railway Road, Rishikesh . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract.
